historical_release.scope: Historical init CLI reproducible build/install; reused unchanged, not a new HTTP candidate build.

installed_execution.script:
"""Use the unchanged init installation with the HTTP journey's mandatory wrapper."""
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import tempfile

assert sys.flags.isolated == 1 and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 13, 12)
assert Path(sys.prefix).resolve() == Path('/tmp/cryptalis-init-cli-py313-20261024')
site = Path(sys.prefix) / 'lib/python3.13/site-packages'
script = Path('/tmp/cryptalis-http-cli-journey-20261024/scripts/test_postgres.py')
# Compile verified source without reading old bytecode or writing into the reused environment.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cryptalis-http-cli-cache-') as cache:
    sys.pycache_prefix = cache
    import cryptalis
    assert Path(cryptalis.__file__).resolve() == site / 'cryptalis/__init__.py'
    sys.argv = [str(script), *sys.argv[1:]]
    try:
        runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name='__main__')
    finally:
        for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
            if name == 'cryptalis' or name.startswith('cryptalis.'):
                assert site in Path(module.__file__).resolve().parents
